map.财产案件案件受理费按诉讼标的额分段累计：不超过 1 万元的每件 50 元；超过: For property cases the acceptance fee accumulates by tier on the claim amount: ¥50 per case up to ¥10,000; 2.5% on the ¥10,000-100,000 portion; 2% on the ¥100,000-200,000 portion; 1.5% on the ¥200,000-500,000 portion; 1% on the ¥500,000-1,000,000 portion. The tiers add up to the total acceptance fee.

map.离婚基础受理费 50–300 元，另对超过 20 万元部分按 0.5% 加收：(: The base divorce fee is ¥50-300, plus 0.5% on the part above ¥200,000: (500000−200000)×0.5% = ¥1,500, about ¥1,550 in total (excluding variation in the base amount).
map.诉讼费谁先交、最终谁承担？: Who pays first, and who bears the fee in the end?
map.由原告预交，案件审结后由败诉方负担；部分胜诉部分败诉的按比例分担；调解、撤诉的减: The plaintiff pays in advance and the losing party bears it after judgment; where each side partly wins, it is apportioned; mediation or withdrawal halves it.
map.申请执行和保全另收费吗？: Are enforcement and preservation charged separately?
map.是的，申请执行费、财产保全申请费、公示催告等按相应标准另行收取，不在案件受理费内: Yes. Enforcement fees, property preservation application fees and public notice fees are charged separately under their own scales and are not part of the acceptance fee.
